paragraphs.text: Burnished-towered Ardestan is a city in Thune on the plane of Shandalar , between the Osai Desert and the Nether Lands . It has rune-warded walls and was the home of Bani Bakur and Ravash Mog .
Ardestan was founded by Kenan Sahrmal .
The city was attacked during Lim-Dûl’s War , twelve years after Leshrac and Tevesh Szat had left the plane.
